RH.form: One formed plate with downturned long edges, rounded eye bulge, dome around eye and exposed threaded rod. Do not flatten or copy LH double-cheek construction.
RH.index_groups: Additional RH close-ups support short stamped ticks plus one elongated index with rounded end dots on each side of eye. Readable group count/spacing still photo inferred, no calibrated graduation claim.
RH.geometry: Dense sampled two-dimensional sheet before forming and finite thickness; exact hole cut; source-integrated real thread. No unknown underside reinforcement or weld specification.

LH.form: Two parallel cheek plates joined by curved rod-end return and visible hollow sleeve across eye gap. This is structurally distinct from RH.
LH.outline: Straight narrow strip with circular eye bulge blended into strip; rounded rectangle ends. Match photographed front proportions rather than forcing related axle dimensions into a fit.
LH.return_method: Original constant-thickness U return in YZ, extruded across cheek front flat edge; outer bend radius about3mm, inner radius outer minus sheet1.6mm. Positive small source overlap into cheeks then exact union, audit closure. No generic solid box across entire gap.
LH.sleeve: Visible open cylindrical bore sleeve, outer surface fits author cheek opening; separate bodies/contact ownership if seam remains. No invented hidden bearing or weld.
LH.rod: Real exterior helix, plain short root into photographed return; thread hand/pitch estimates, no certified standard.

endplate.form: Raised rounded rectangular pressing, three holes and perimeter return. Do not use flat washer.
endplate.section_working: Outer46x33mm; side holes atX±18mm/r1.8mm. Boss base about30x22mm leaves flat side-hole flanges; crown about22x14mm raised7mm, rounded corners. Values remain estimates within child bounds.
endplate.mesh: Nested sampled rounded-rectangle rings with dense interpolation through pressed shoulders; front/back finite sheet surfaces. Exact center r4.2mm and side cuts. Perimeter return observed; reverse sheet continuation estimated, not reverse reinforcement reconstruction.

torque_arm.form: Long pressed/beaded strap with broad asymmetric end ears, unequal apparent hole sizes and shaped tips, distinct from PF161001 actuation rod. Two photos do not establish both faces.
torque_arm.mesh: Dense sheet grid along300mm working axis and across width; waist16mm, end24mm, raised center bead about3.5mm, 2.2mm finite sheet. Fade bead toward flat end ears. Round/chamfer asymmetrical end contour from photos, not a plain rectangle or cylinder.
torque_arm.holes: Working left radius4.8mm/right4mm at flat ears; no boss or bushing invented, no fitted plane/bolt claim.

torque_bolt.form: One representative DH151029 from four-piece photo, not four duplicates. Hex head, small round shoulder transition, long plain shoulder, reduced helical end, observed transverse tip mouth.
torque_bolt.working_profile: Head AF13mm/height5mm; shoulder r5mm; end crest r4mm/pitch1.25mm/length14mm, total32mm; mouth r1.2mm near tip. Child bounds govern, related nut label is not physical metrology.
torque_bolt.hole_boundary: Conservative one-side mouth with open inner axial-plane review continuation if opposite exit remains unverified, same principle as rear axle.
torque_bolt.limits: No guessed grade stamps, separate washer/flange ownership, hidden pin style, hardware standard or mounted fit.
